note.label: Daniel 10: A Man Clothed in Linen

precepts.why:
From the first day Daniel set his heart to understand and to chasten himself before the Most High, his words were heard. That is Solomon's prayer being answered: “When thy people Israel be smitten down before the enemy, because they have sinned against thee, and shall turn again to thee, and confess thy name, and pray, and make supplication unto thee in this house: Then hear thou in heaven, and forgive the sin of thy people Israel, and bring them again unto the land which thou gavest unto their fathers.”

Israel was smitten because they sinned, and Daniel turned again, confessed and made supplication. The Most High heard Daniel's supplications and prayer because he was beloved, a man greatly beloved, and gave him these visions of what shall befall his people in the latter days for the same reason. It is the same with Israel, the beloved of the Most High: when Israel turns again, confesses and makes supplication, he will hear and forgive.

note.label: Bishop Nathanyel | Revelation 1 A Visit From The Lord

precepts.why:
“Then I lifted up mine eyes, and looked, and behold a certain man clothed in linen, whose loins were girded with fine gold of Uphaz:” A golden girdle. “His body also was like the beryl,” Beryl means green. It is the same description we read in Revelation 1. “and his face as the appearance of lightning,” He had a glow on his face. “and his eyes as lamps of fire,” Genesis 49:12: he drank wine, his eyes shall be red with wine. “and his arms and his feet like in colour to polished brass,” Polished brass means brass burned in a furnace. That is what that means: meaning he was black.

And where Revelation says his countenance was as the sun shineth in his strength, Daniel says his face was like the appearance of lightning: he had a glow about him.

points: Things happen in the spiritual realm you cannot see: the Lord and the angels guide men. The Lord had Trump kill the Ayatollah, his family, Larijani and tiers of Iran's leadership, and whoso sheddeth man's blood, by man shall his blood be shed.

An example of God ruling in the kingdom of men: Christ tells Daniel he returns to fight the prince of Persia, and the prince of Grecia shall come. The Lord was creating war, transferring power to Alexander, while the spirit of Satan in the king of Persia resisted.
In the third year of Cyrus king of Persia, a thing was revealed unto Daniel, whose name was called Belteshazzar, and the thing was true but the time appointed was long, and he understood the vision.

note.label: Daniel 10: A Man Clothed in Linen

points: Daniel was mourning three full weeks, eating no pleasant bread, no flesh or wine, and did not anoint himself until the three weeks were fulfilled.

note.label: Daniel 10: A Man Clothed in Linen

points: By the side of the great river Hiddekel, Daniel lifted his eyes and saw a certain man clothed in linen, his loins girded with fine gold of Uphaz, his body like the beryl, his face as lightning, his eyes as lamps of fire, his arms and feet like polished brass, and his voice like the voice of a multitude.

note.label: Daniel 10: A Man Clothed in Linen

points: Daniel alone saw the vision; the men with him did not see it but a great quaking fell on them and they fled. Daniel was left alone, his strength turned to corruption, and he fell into a deep sleep on his face toward the ground.

note.label: Daniel 10: A Man Clothed in Linen

points: A hand touched Daniel and set him upon his knees and palms, and he was told he is a man greatly beloved, to understand the words spoken and stand upright, for he was now sent to him.

note.label: Daniel 10: A Man Clothed in Linen

points: The one speaking told Daniel that from the first day he set his heart to understand and to chasten himself before the Most High, his words were heard, and he came for his words. The Most High heard Daniel's supplications and prayer because he was beloved, and gave him these visions for the same reason. It is the same with Israel, the beloved of the Most High.

note.label: Daniel 10: A Man Clothed in Linen

points: The prince of the kingdom of Persia withstood him twenty-one days, until Michael, one of the chief princes, came to help him. He came to make Daniel understand what shall befall his people in the latter days, for the vision is for many days.

Michael and Gabriel contending with the prince of Persia and the prince of Grecia shows that there are angels set over cities and even governments. The Most High has his angels everywhere, as with the angels that came and dealt with Sodom and Gomorrah.

note.label: Daniel 10: A Man Clothed in Linen

points: Daniel set his face toward the ground and became dumb, until one like the similitude of the sons of men touched his lips, and he opened his mouth and spoke of his sorrows and lack of strength.

note.label: Daniel 10: A Man Clothed in Linen

points: One like the appearance of a man touched him again and strengthened him, telling him not to fear, for he is greatly beloved, and Daniel was strengthened to hear his lord speak.

note.label: Daniel 10: A Man Clothed in Linen

points: The messenger told Daniel he would return to fight with the prince of Persia, and when he is gone forth, the prince of Grecia shall come.

note.label: Daniel 10: A Man Clothed in Linen

points: He would show Daniel that which is noted in the scripture of truth, and none holds with him in these things but Michael, Israel's prince. Even the close of chapter 10 validates chapters 7 and 8, letting it be known that Greece came and overthrew the Persians and the Medes.
